outline:
This class will teach students to understand the mega trend, current status, market requirements, regulations, and future challenges of the new energy vehicles. The following new energy vehicle technologies will be shared including e-bike, e-scooter, battery electric vehicle (BEV), hybrid electric vehicle (HEV), plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV), fuel-cell hybrid electric vehicle (FCHEV). Also, the key components of the new energy vehicle including hi-efficiency internal combustion engine (ICE), turbo-charger, motor, transmission, battery (VRLA, NiMH, Li-Ion, Fuel-cell), controls, chargers, and chip-sets will be shared on the class too.
The group study and presentation will be included to show the process of problem identification, scenario development to meet the city regulation, environment, demonstration, economic, and smart transportation requirements by selection of e-bike, e-scooter, BEV, or HEV to design and design your group presentation.
schedule:
1. Week 1-4: To introduce the energy vehicle and to study the mega trend, current status, market requirements, regulations, and future challenges of the new energy vehicles to layout your group project design.
2. Week 5-9: To introduce the technological features of e-bike, e-scooter, BEV, HEV, PHEV, FCHEV.
3. Week 10-14: To introduce the key components of the new energy vehicle including ICE, turbo-charger, motor, transmission, batteries, controls, chargers, and chip-sets.
4. Week 15-19: To consolidate all studies and innovate values to your group study to finalize your group presentation.
scorePolicy:
1. To layout your group project design of the new energy vehicles: 10%
2. Mid-term written test: 20%
3. Mid-term group presentation: 20%
4. Final written test: 20%
5. Final group presentation: 30%
